posts.title: The AI stories we're not telling
posts.description: When OpenAI unveiled a new ChatGPT voice interface in 2024, Sam Altman posted one word on X. "her." This simple post earned 21 million views. He wasn't describing a product feature. He was pointing at a 2013 Spike Jonze movie called Her, in which a man falls in love with his AI assistant. posts.title: Where I'm Heading - How My Offer Is Changing
posts.description: In my time as a product coach, I’ve seen countless changes within our industry and ways of working—I don’t think I need to list them all here, but let’s just say that there have been many waves of disruption and transformation over the past decade.
